text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Shannon Lawrence has resigned from the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee effective June 3, 2025. We would like to thank Shannon for their contributions to the Committee. City staff will lead a process to bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration to fill this vacancy and the vacancy resulting from the resignation of Efia Tekyi-Annan on April 8, 2025.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
